localizedDescriptions.zh: 桌面掌握包裹动态，随手查看取件码与取件地点。支持多尺寸小组件、手动刷新与会话过期自动续期，需配合 Loon 和 BoxJS 使用。
localizedDescriptions.en: Track parcels, pickup codes and pickup locations from your Home Screen. Includes multiple widget sizes, manual refresh and automatic session renewal. Requires Loon and BoxJS.
